== Building five: the chapel ==

=== Prayer instructor ===
[[File:Brother Brace chathead.png|left]]
In the [[Tutorial Island chapel]], the monk [[Brother Brace]] instructs players in the [[Prayer]] skill, the Prayer list, the use of Prayers, [[Prayer points]] and recharging those, and gaining Prayer experience by burying [[bones]]. ''Note: as explained in the [[#Combat_Instructor|combat section]] on this page, at this stage of the tutorial it is no longer possible to train Prayer until you travel to the mainland unless you have gathered some bones during your time in the rat pen.''

Upstairs in the chapel, the player can find an [[Church organ|organ]] on which several tunes can be played.

=== Ironman Mode ===
[[File:Ironman tutor (Tutorial Island) chathead.png|left]]
When following the road to the next and last building on the island, players will come across [[Ironman tutor (Tutorial Island)|Paul]], who will introduce them to [[Ironman Mode]].

{{List|c=1
|*'''[[Ironman Mode#Standard|Standard]]''' Ironmen will have ''restrictions'' imposed on them: they cannot trade, take items belonging to other players, nor accept their help. In other words, they are ''entirely self-sufficient'' and do everything for themselves.
*'''[[Ironman Mode#Hardcore|Hardcore]]''' Ironmen not only face the standard restrictions, but also have ''only one life''. In the event of a [[death]] that is not [[Minigames#Minigames|safe]], the Hardcore status will be downgraded to a standard and the stats will be frozen on the Hardcore Ironman [[hiscores]].
*'''[[Ironman Mode#Ultimate|Ultimate]]''' Ironmen, in addition to the standard restrictions, ''cannot use the [[bank]]''. When they die, '''all''' carried items will be dropped directly to the ground and will remain there for an hour after death, after which the items will [[despawn]].}}

As long as the player is on Tutorial Island they can switch freely between the three modes and being a normal player. Once they leave the island, they can speak to [[Ironman tutor|Adam the Ironman tutor]] in [[Lumbridge]] to switch further. However, Adam will let the player switch restrictions ''only downwards'': from higher to lower, the order is: Ultimate/Hardcore -> Standard -> non-Ironmen.

Note that once a mode is chosen, players have one week to change their mind; once the week is over, players may not undo the changes. Players can also choose to become a [[Group Ironman Mode|Group Ironman]], which allows groups of up to five people to play with a shared bank but with the restrictions above. Players who select this option can continue to [[The Node]] south of the final building.
